tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: I bought a lovely wooden table.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “What did you buy at the market?” (Add did.)

B hears the question and builds the answer. Put the adjectives in the right order: opinion, size, age, colour, origin, material, then the noun. Choose a or an, and change the blue verb if you need to.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Opinion, then size, age, colour, material: 'a lovely old wooden table'.
